name: Drawer
usage: Details and editing that keep the context of a list, such as member details, permission settings or conversation settings

props.name: open
props.description:
Whether the drawer is shown. Set it to false in `onClose`. Keep the Drawer rendered and switch `open`: a Drawer
that is rendered only while it is open (`{show && <Drawer open />}`) disappears at once when it closes, without
its closing animation.

props.name: children
props.description:
Content of the drawer. It is unmounted after the drawer has closed (when the closing animation ends), so a form
in it starts afresh the next time the drawer opens. State owned outside the drawer survives.

props.name: footer
props.description:
Actions at the bottom, such as Cancel and Save, laid out with Inline (`justify="end"`). The footer stays
visible while the content scrolls.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the user closes the drawer: the close button, `Esc` or a click outside the drawer.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the drawer: a number in pixels or a CSS length.

props.name: testId
props.description: Test hook, rendered as `data-testid` on the drawer.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Slides in from the right to show details while keeping the context of the list.

examples.name: WithFooter
examples.title: Footer actions
examples.description:
Put Cancel and Save in `footer`: they stay at the bottom while the content scrolls. Submit the form from the
footer with the instance from `Form.useForm()`.
